zh.what: Linux 上的 Agent J 专用浏览器改用电脑已有的 Chrome 或 Chromium，使用独立浏览器资料。运行 `agentj browser check` 查看状态。
zh.action: 运行 `agentj browser check` 查看状态。

en.what: On Linux, the Agent J browser uses Chrome or Chromium already on your computer, with a separate browser profile. Run `agentj browser check` to see its status.
en.action: Run `agentj browser check` to see its status.

zh.what: macOS 和 Windows（beta）推荐使用 Ego Lite。你可以请 Agent 从官网下载。
zh.action: 安装并完成设置后，运行 `agentj browser connect`，再用已配对的遥控器确认。

en.what: Agent J recommends Ego Lite on macOS and Windows (beta). You can ask your Agent to download it from the official site.
en.action: After setup, run `agentj browser connect` and confirm on your paired remote.

zh.what: Agent J 自带 Ego Lite 使用技能，Claude Code、Codex 和 OpenCode 都可以读取。
zh.action: 连接前请关闭 Ego Lite 的「产品改进」选项。

en.what: Agent J includes an Ego Lite skill that Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode can read.
en.action: Turn off Product Improvement in Ego Lite before connecting.
